description: Java class 'ConnectionStatus' manages connection state within a robotics or engine control software. It tracks connection status, responds to various event listeners (engine time, sensor updates, messages), and notifies registered listeners about connection changes.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus
classes.description: Manages and signals the connection status of the system, using event listeners for various system components.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus.Value
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible connection states: NOT_CONNECTED, LOADING, CONNECTED.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus.Listener
classes.description: Interface for classes that want to be notified when connection status changes.

methods.name: executeOnceConnected
methods.description: Executes the provided Runnable once the system is connected.

methods.name: markConnected
methods.description: Marks the system as connected and resets the timeout timer.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the current connection state and notifies listeners if it changes.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if the system is currently connected.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current connection state value.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified on connection status changes.
